name: Monorepo & Workspace Management
description: Monorepo & Workspace Management standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-MONOREPO applies.

rules.title: Define package ownership and dependency boundaries
rules.detail: Each workspace/package has an owner, public API and allowed dependency direction; circular package dependencies are prohibited unless explicitly approved.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define package ownership and dependency boundaries.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define package ownership and dependency boundaries.

rules.title: Use one deterministic dependency installation model
rules.detail: Lockfiles, package-manager version and workspace configuration must produce reproducible installs in local development and CI.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use one deterministic dependency installation model.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use one deterministic dependency installation model.

rules.title: Run affected checks without weakening global quality gates
rules.detail: Use dependency graph based affected builds/tests when available, but repository-wide validation remains available for release and structural changes.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Run affected checks without weakening global quality gates.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Run affected checks without weakening global quality gates.

rules.title: Centralize shared tooling without hiding project-specific requirements
rules.detail: Lint, TypeScript, test and build presets may be shared, while package-specific overrides remain explicit and minimal.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Centralize shared tooling without hiding project-specific requirements.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Centralize shared tooling without hiding project-specific requirements.

rules.title: Version and publish internal packages intentionally
rules.detail: Choose fixed or independent versioning and define compatibility/deprecation behavior for shared packages consumed outside the repository.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Version and publish internal packages intentionally.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Version and publish internal packages intentionally.

rules.title: Prevent accidental cross-package coupling
rules.detail: Do not import another package internal file path; consume only declared public exports.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent accidental cross-package coupling.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent accidental cross-package coupling.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-MONOREPO applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Monorepo & Workspace Management to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Monorepo & Workspace Management is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Monorepo & Workspace Management failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
